evidence.quote_en: In the period 1800-1803 he indeed accompanied Elgin to Athens, where he made numerous surveys of the monuments of the Acropolis of the Hephaisteion and of the choragic monuments of Thrasyllus and Lysicrates in Athens, of the excavations of Eleusis, of Corinth and in various centers of the Peloponnese.

evidence.quote: Nel 1804 rientra a Catania, dedicandosi allo studio e al rilievo dei monumenti antichi e al disegno di piante urbane e territoriali e vedute poi incise su rame, tra cui un'importante planimetria di Catania per la cui realizzazione impiegò più di 25 anni, dal 1806 al 1832, fatta incidere durante un lungo soggiorno a Parigi, dove fu invitato da Jakob Ignaz Hittorff, famoso architetto parigino e suo amico, conosciuto nel 1823, durante il viaggio in Sicilia di quest'ultimo, anch'esso studioso di antichità classiche.
evidence.quote_en: In 1804 he returned to Catania, dedicating himself to the study and survey of ancient monuments and to the drawing of urban and territorial plans and views later engraved on copper, including an important map of Catania for whose realization he spent more than 25 years, from 1806 to 1832, which he had engraved during a long stay in Paris, where he was invited by Jakob Ignaz Hittorff, a famous Parisian architect and his friend, met in 1823, during the latter's journey in Sicily, also a scholar of classical antiquities.

evidence.quote_en: Finally, of the two castaways, only Pedro Serrano was rescued in 1534, eight years after the shipwreck.

evidence.quote: Педро Серрано (исп. Pedro Serrano) — испанский капитан, который в 1526 году после кораблекрушения оказался на одном из песчаных берегов атолла Карибского моря, теперь называемого Серрана-Банка, в 130 морских милях от островов Сан-Андрес.
evidence.quote_en: Pedro Serrano (Spanish: Pedro Serrano) was a Spanish captain who in 1526, after a shipwreck, found himself on one of the sandy shores of the Caribbean Sea atoll, now called Serrana Bank, 130 nautical miles from the islands of San Andrés.

evidence.quote: Только в 1534 году он был спасен испанским судном, проведя восемь лет на пустынной земле.
evidence.quote_en: Only in 1534 was he rescued by a Spanish ship, having spent eight years on the deserted land.

evidence.quote: Педро Луіс Серрано був іспанським моряком, який, як припускається, вижив протягом восьми років (1526—1534) на невеликому безлюдному піщаному острові «Serrana Bank» (названий саме на честь Педро Серрано).
evidence.quote_en: Pedro Luis Serrano was a Spanish sailor who is believed to have survived for eight years (1526–1534) on a small uninhabited sandy island, "Serrana Bank" (named in honor of Pedro Serrano).

evidence.quote: 佩德羅·塞拉諾（Pedro Serrano），是一位在16世紀初曾流落在加勒比海的一個荒島（該島以他的名字命名為塞拉納島）上的西班牙人。
evidence.quote_en: Pedro Serrano was a Spaniard who was stranded on a desert island in the Caribbean (the island was named Serrana Island after him) in the early 16th century.

evidence.quote: 1528年，佩德羅·塞拉諾所乘搭的船，在加勒比海海域中沉沒，由於他的水性良好，游到附近一座荒島上，即因他而命名的塞拉納島（Serrana Bank）
evidence.quote_en: In 1528, the ship Pedro Serrano was traveling on sank in the Caribbean Sea. Because of his good swimming skills, he swam to a nearby desert island, which was named Serrana Bank after him.

evidence.quote: Pedro Luis Serrano est un marin espagnol, connu pour être resté bloqué sept ou huit ans sur une petite île déserte, au XVIe siècle.
evidence.quote_en: Pedro Luis Serrano is a Spanish sailor, known for being stranded seven or eight years on a small desert island in the 16th century.

evidence.quote: Pedro Serrano war ein spanischer Seefahrer.
evidence.quote_en: Pedro Serrano was a Spanish sailor.

evidence.quote: Er wurde als Überlebender eines Schiffsunglücks im Jahre 1528 berühmt, das ihn auf einer Sandbank in der Karibik stranden ließ. Erst 1536 wurde er gerettet.
evidence.quote_en: He became famous as the survivor of a shipwreck in 1528, which left him stranded on a sandbank in the Caribbean. He was not rescued until 1536.

evidence.quote: Jan Nosko (ur. 1 maja 1940 w Koziakach, ZSRR) – polski działacz partyjny i państwowy, historyk nauki i specjalista zdrowia publicznego, doktor habilitowany nauk humanistycznych, w latach 1983–1988 wiceprezydent Łodzi i z urzędu wicewojewoda łódzki.
evidence.quote_en: Jan Nosko (born 1 May 1940 in Koziaki, USSR) – Polish party and state activist, historian of science and public health specialist, habilitated doctor of humanities, in the years 1983–1988 vice-president of Łódź and ex officio vice-voivode of Łódź.

evidence.quote: W latach 1953–1957 należał do Związku Młodzieży Polskiej, a od 1960 do 1969 – do Związku Młodzieży Socjalistycznej, gdzie kierował zarządem łódzkim.
evidence.quote_en: In the years 1953–1957 he belonged to the Polish Youth Union, and from 1960 to 1969 – to the Socialist Youth Union, where he headed the Łódź board.

evidence.quote: W 2006 uzyskał stopień doktora habilitowanego nauk humanistycznych na podstawie pracy pt. Zachowania zdrowotne i zdrowie publiczne.
evidence.quote_en: In 2006, he obtained the degree of habilitated doctor of humanities on the basis of the work entitled Health behaviors and public health.
